scope: First held-out scenario grid; not independent field samples or safety certification
selection: Development-only choice: retain original 0.15 switching penalty and add 25 physics ticks (0.5s) minimum residence; prioritise sub-0.5m joint development MAE and fewer switches
ablation: For EarlyPredictive and AdaptivePredictive, compare dwell 0 and 25 at identical penalty and conditions
primary: Fraction stopped within absolute 5m target tolerance; retain failures
restrictions: No test-driven retuning. Development seeds 1000/1001 excluded. Report deterministic scenarios as a finite set, not 64 independent random draws. No confidence interval interpreted as real-world probability. Broader mass/grip/delay/noise remain untested.
